description: Every Pinterest v5 endpoint plus period-over-period analytics, Pin hygiene audits, and offline Pin search.

novel_features.name: Period-over-period performance
novel_features.description: See whether impressions, saves, and outbound clicks grew versus the previous equal-length period, with absolute and percent deltas.

novel_features.name: Pin hygiene audit
novel_features.description: Find published Pins missing alt text, a destination link, a title, or UTM tracking, grouped by board. Reads the local store; run sync first.

novel_features.name: Pin preflight
novel_features.description: Validate a proposed Pin (field limits, board and section by name, UTM link) and get a ready-to-send create body without writing anything. Board names resolve from the local store; run sync first.

novel_features.name: Save to outbound-click funnel
novel_features.description: Rank your top Pins by impressions (or --sort-by metric), compute save and outbound-click rates, and flag Pins that get saved but don't send traffic.

novel_features.name: Trend content gaps
novel_features.description: List trending keywords for a region with how many of your synced Pins cover each, zero-coverage first. Coverage counts need a synced local store.

novel_features.name: One-shot ads report
novel_features.description: Create, wait for, and download an ads performance report in one command. Requires the ads:read scope and --ad-account-id (or PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID).
